title: 列表侧滑
eyebrow: 横竖意图消歧 · 露出吸附与全滑提交
eyebrowEn: Axis Disambiguation · Reveal Snap & Overswipe Commit
summary: 列表行向左侧滑时，8px 矢量消歧区分纵向滚动与横向侧滑；释放时依据位移与阻尼裁定回弹、吸附露出快捷操作，或超过深滑阈值直接全滑提交删除。
summaryEn: Swiping a list row left disambiguates axis intent within an 8px deadband. On release, it resolves between spring rollback, action tray snap reveal, or direct deletion past the deep overswipe commit threshold.
asks: 列表行向左侧滑时，手势如何区分横竖意图，并在操作露出与全滑提交之间裁定？
asksEn: When swiping a list row horizontally, how should gestures disambiguate axis intent and resolve between action reveal and overswipe commit?

links.when: 列表侧滑操作是多状态快捷手势体系，不是单纯的危险操作拦截滑块
links.whenEn: swipe action is a multi-action gesture system, not merely a single destructive confirm slider

links.when: 列表侧滑露出针对单行的就近动作，长按则是激活列表多选批处理模式
links.whenEn: swipe action reveals single-row actions, while long-press activates batch selection

links.when: 侧滑是列表内部各行的水平局部接管，下拉刷新是顶部容器级的纵向接管
links.whenEn: swipe action is intra-row horizontal gesture, pull-to-refresh is container-level vertical

links.when: 侧滑是露出动作面板或触发提交，不是拖拽改变记录的排序位置
links.whenEn: swipe is revealing actions or committing, not reordering items
